name: adlytics-infra
description: CDK v2 infrastructure. Verified against npm 2026-08-18.

scripts.//cdk: Driven from the root Makefile, which requires PROFILE explicitly. No profile is baked in here: a hardcoded one would target our account from a customer's checkout.

//pins.aws-cdk-lib vs aws-cdk: Different version lines by design — the library is 2.273.x and the CLI is 2.1145.x. Never pin them to the same string (ADR-005).
//pins.constructs: aws-cdk-lib 2.273.0 declares a peer of ^10.5.0, so anything below 10.5 fails to install.
//pins.typescript: Held at 5.9.3 deliberately. TypeScript 7.0 is released, but ts-jest declares a peer of >=4.3 <7, so 7.x breaks the test toolchain today.
//pins.@types/node: 24.x to match the Node 24 LTS runtime target, not the newest 26.x line.
//pins.aws-cdk-lib 2.273.0: First release checked that bundles brace-expansion 5.0.12, the first patched version for GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7, GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p and GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr (A-CVE-CDK-BUNDLED-001). A bundled dependency cannot be overridden, so the library version is the fix.
//pins.overrides: handlebars 4.7.10 is the first patched version for GHSA-8r5x-fm3f-whwj, GHSA-p8wg-vrv2-v86f and GHSA-xw65-4hp5-5hc7 (O-ASH-CVE-HANDLEBARS-001). It reaches the tree only through ts-jest (handlebars@^4.7.9), so this is test-time only. @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config's js-yaml 3 is lifted to 4.3.2, whose argparse 2 has no dependencies, so sprintf-js 1.0.3 (GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c, no patched release) leaves the lockfile (O-ASH-SPRINTF-JS-001). The package calls only js-yaml's load(), which 4.x keeps with the safe schema as its default.
//pins.node: Engine pinned to the Node 24 LTS line, enforced by engine-strict in .npmrc so a wrong runtime fails the install rather than warning. 26.x is Current, not LTS, and infra-style-cdk bans targeting it. 20.x is end-of-life.
